title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Why are the newly added fields in drop-down not displayed? (e.g., adding item Search Description to DropDown fieldgroup)
summary: When adding fields to a drop-down field group in a table, newly added fields may not display if they are hidden on the underlying lookup page. To fix this, modify the page extension to set the field's Visibility property to true.
key_points: Field groups (DropDown) define which fields appear in drop-down controls when selecting records from a list
Fields added to a DropDown field group won't show if they have Visibility = false on the lookup page
The solution requires both a table extension with the DropDown field group and a page extension to make hidden fields visible
The Item table uses the Item Lookup page as its lookup page, which hides certain fields by default

quotes.text: If the field you're adding to the DropDown has Visibility = false on the underlying lookup page, it won't show up in the drop-down.
quotes.why_it_matters: This explains the root cause of missing fields in drop-down controls and is the key insight for troubleshooting
